marketing.pacing.fastHook.ad1.cta: Want to see her flip the game? Keep watching.
marketing.pacing.fastHook.ad1.hook: Humiliated at the opening -> instant payback
marketing.pacing.fastHook.ad2.cta: The next episode reveals the truth.
marketing.pacing.fastHook.cliffhanger: Reveal the key identity or threat in the final 3 seconds.
marketing.pacing.fastHook.description: Explode within 5 seconds, land the first twist inside 30 seconds, and lock the next episode with a clear cliffhanger.
marketing.pacing.fastHook.escalationPlan: Raise humiliation or betrayal emotions quickly in 20-40 seconds.
marketing.pacing.fastHook.label: Fast hook sprint
marketing.pacing.fastHook.openingHook: Use one line or action to ignite conflict within 5 seconds.
marketing.pacing.fastHook.payoffPlan: Use the last 2-3 seconds for a clear counterattack or identity reversal.
marketing.pacing.fastHook.reversalDescri: Reverse identity or stance to drive the revenge beat.
marketing.pacing.slowBurn.ad1.cta: The ending is about to be revealed.
marketing.pacing.slowBurn.ad1.visual: Eye contact, turning away, tear beat
marketing.pacing.slowBurn.cliffhanger: Use an emotional choice as the episode hook.
marketing.pacing.slowBurn.description: Plant early foreshadowing, compress pressure, and release emotion around 60-80 seconds—great for relationship arcs.
marketing.pacing.slowBurn.escalationPlan: Deepen the misunderstanding and emotional pressure step by step.
marketing.pacing.slowBurn.label: Emotional escalation
marketing.pacing.slowBurn.openingHook: Open by naming the key relationship and taboo.
marketing.pacing.slowBurn.payoffPlan: Close on an emotional release or decisive choice.
marketing.pacing.twistHeavy.ad1.cta: Don’t blink, the twists are not over.
marketing.pacing.twistHeavy.ad1.hook: Rapid twists that keep viewers stunned
marketing.pacing.twistHeavy.ad2.cta: Unlock the next plot turn now.
marketing.pacing.twistHeavy.ad2.hook: A chain of twists stacked back to back
marketing.pacing.twistHeavy.cliffhanger: Use an unrevealed secret as the next-episode hook.
marketing.pacing.twistHeavy.description: At least two twists per episode with rapid emotional swings and reaction shots that accelerate payoff release.
marketing.pacing.twistHeavy.escalationPl: Insert a twist, misunderstanding, or exposure every 20 seconds.
marketing.pacing.twistHeavy.hookDescript: Start with an irreversible conflict result.
marketing.pacing.twistHeavy.label: High-density twists
marketing.pacing.twistHeavy.openingHook: Open with the result of the conflict or an explosive image.
marketing.pacing.twistHeavy.payoffPlan: End with a second reversal that creates shock.
marketing.pacing.twistHeavy.reversalDesc: Double reversal in the middle section.

shortDrama.scriptTemplate.hitStructure.d: Forces an opening hook, a catharsis beat, and an ending cliffhanger, and requires scenes.notes to mark HOOK / PAYOFF / CLIFFHANGER.
shortDrama.scriptTemplate.hitStructure.r: Write with a breakout short-drama structure: the first 10 seconds must explode with a hook, the middle must escalate quickly, the ending must contain one clear filmable payoff event, and the final scene must leave a larger suspense or crisis escalation. Mark HOOK / PAYOFF / CLIFFHANGER in scenes[].notes. Keep dialogue short, emotional, physical, and information-dense—avoid filler and ellipses.
shortDrama.storyTemplate.engagement.desc: Start with public humiliation and betrayal, flip the evidence mid-episode, then end on a larger conspiracy cliffhanger—great for workplace and wealthy-family revenge arcs.
shortDrama.storyTemplate.engagement.requ: Hard rule: every episode must include one filmable catharsis beat (slap-back, counterattack, exposure, punishment, reversal, rescue, confession) plus an escalated end hook; keep 3-6 scenes per episode, reuse major locations when possible, and keep dialogue sharp and information-dense.
shortDrama.storyTemplate.engagement.them: Betrayal and revenge, identity reversal, righteous payback
shortDrama.storyTemplate.engagement.worl: Power in wealthy families and the workplace collides across an engagement banquet, company projects, and capital undercurrents; evidence trails and identity arcs run through the story.
